caption: Aalborghus, Aalborg
composition: Red-timber east wing and the moat · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: From the public side of the moat, Aalborghus shows yellow monk-brick outer walls and a red tile roof, with grass ramparts behind dark water. The grounds are empty. The night is overcast, about 12.1°C. The cloud deck hides the moon, and a few lamps carry the light. The steel Limfjord bridge and the Utzon roofs are not in this frame.
